# Mann Dev

> Custom websites and web apps built from scratch in Montréal. No templates, no page builders — just clean, fast code you own outright.

Mann Dev is a solo web design and development practice run by Julien Mann, based in Montréal, Québec, working remotely worldwide. Every project is hand-coded — no templates, no page builders — with a focus on performance, accessibility, and code the client owns outright.

## Services

- [Landing Page](https://dev.julienmann.ca/#services): A single, focused page built to convert. Custom design, fully responsive, deployed within a few days.
- [Full Website](https://dev.julienmann.ca/#services): Multi-page site covering about, services, portfolio, and contact. Custom design system, CMS integration if needed.
- [Care & Hosting](https://dev.julienmann.ca/#services): Flat monthly rate for managed hosting, uptime monitoring, security patches, and ongoing support.
- [AI Automation](https://dev.julienmann.ca/#services): Custom AI-powered workflows, chatbots, and automations built into existing tools or as standalone systems.
